indicators.note: away suggests the letters of the word before it are sent off and scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A news report that a senior army officer has died.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away' rearranges PASSED. 'Major' looks like an army rank, but in bridge spades and hearts are the major suits.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, spades is one of the two major suits, along with hearts.

definitions.meaning: a bed in the garden, a patch of ground for planting
a scheme or plan, as in a ... against someone

explanation.definitionFit: A plot is both a small piece of ground for growing things and a secret plan or scheme.

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece placed on top of the next comes first

parts.note: a digit is a single number from 0 to 9
the name Ali with its 's run together gives these letters

explanation.surface: A boxer such as Ali is accused of taking a certain number of drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'on' puts DIGIT above ALIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Digitalis is a heart medicine made from foxglove leaves, so it is a drug.

definitions.meaning: soft to the touch, without roughness
to iron is to press creases flat

explanation.definitionFit: Smooth as an adjective means soft and even; as a verb it means to press flat, as an iron does.

parts.note: reads as the lowest ranks of the fleet, but a group of underwater vessels is meant, and a smaller set within a larger one

explanation.definitionFit: A subgroup is a smaller division within a larger group, and a sub is a naval submarine.

clue.text: How a lucky florist comes out after a shave?

definitions.text: How a lucky florist comes out after a shave?

parts.words: How a lucky florist comes out after a shave?
parts.note: a close shave is a narrow escape; someone who escapes trouble unharmed is said to come out with a sweet scent, which a florist would have anyway

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for coming out of a bad situation looking good is to come up with a sweet floral scent.

clue.text: Flighty creatures can be subtle about it

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece surrounds the other
can be suggests the letters of the word after it may be turned into another order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Fickle people can be subtle about something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can be' makes BLUETS, which 'about' wraps round the other piece. 'Flighty' looks like fickle but means able to fly.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue tits are small birds, so creatures that take flight.

clue.text: Bishop is stabling a champion horse

indicators.note: stabling means housing an animal, so one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop
an ace is a champion or expert

explanation.surface: A bishop keeps a prize-winning horse in his stable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is stabling' puts one piece inside the other. RR stands for Right Reverend, the title of a bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: A racer is a horse bred and trained for racing.

parts.note: 'got' in the sense of understood: books whose writing makes no sense to anyone, not books that are out of stock

explanation.definitionFit: Books too dense or badly written to make sense of cannot be read at all.

clue.text: Crafty creature has cover in plant

parts.note: the fox is proverbially cunning
a glove covers the hand

explanation.surface: A cunning animal has hidden itself among the vegetation.
explanation.definitionFit: The foxglove is a tall flowering plant, the source of digitalis.

clue.text: Sores start suppurating after cruel operation

indicators.note: one piece comes after the other in the answer
an operation works on something and changes it, so these letters are reworked into a new order
the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Wounds begin to weep after a brutal surgical procedure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'operation' shuffles the five letters of the cruel word; 'start' takes the first letter of 'suppurating', placed 'after' it. 'Cruel operation' poses as a brutal surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: Ulcers are open sores on the skin or a membrane.

indicators.note: dabbling means messing around with something, so the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: An authoritarian man from Italy plays about with fortune-telling cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dabbling with' rearranges ITALIAN and TAROT together.
explanation.definitionFit: A totalitarian state allows no opposition, so it is the opposite of democratic.

indicators.note: swinging moves things round, so these letters are swung into a new order

explanation.surface: An athlete is accused of pretending to be ill (British 'swinging the lead') and so on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swinging' rearranges THE LEAD ETC. To 'swing the lead' is British slang for faking illness to avoid work.
explanation.definitionFit: A decathlete is an athlete who competes in the ten-event decathlon.
Deal is a word for softwood planks, and a deal is also a business transaction or bargain.

clue.text: People with "A" start to learn Greek, say

parts.note: a nation is a people

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Folk with a top grade begin to study Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek is an example of a national, a citizen of a particular country.

clue.text: Result of too much oil on lighter?

parts.note: on top of means over
a spill is a thin strip of wood or paper for lighting a fire

explanation.surface: Pouring excess fuel into a cigarette lighter makes a mess.
explanation.walkthrough: A spill is a thin taper used for lighting a fire or pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Overspill is liquid that floods over when too much is poured.

clue.text: Acting managers and what they say to leaky defences?

definitions.meaning: temporary bosses filling in until a permanent one is found

definitions.text: what they say to leaky defences
definitions.meaning: a football manager shouting to a defence full of holes to close them

explanation.walkthrough: Read the second part as a command: 'Stop gaps!' to a defence letting goals in.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopgap is a temporary replacement, and as an order it tells a porous defence to close its holes.

clue.text: River argument shows singer raising voice

parts.note: the Fal is a river in Cornwall
a set-to is a quarrel or fight

explanation.surface: A row by the river ends with a singer shouting.
explanation.walkthrough: The Fal is a river in Cornwall, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Falsetto is a voice pitched above its natural range, used here for one who sings in it.

indicators.note: inside means the letters are found within the words that follow it

explanation.surface: These fish are slimy to the touch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' finds the letters in feEL Slippery.
explanation.definitionFit: Eels are long snake-like fish.

indicators.note: about suggests being turned around, so these letters come out in a new order

explanation.surface: Something is buzzing around a royal seat.
explanation.definitionFit: A hornet is a large wasp, an insect that flies.

indicators.note: random means in no fixed order, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Wardens order an unannounced search of a jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Chairpersons run meetings and committees, so they direct proceedings.

definitions.meaning: to put a body in a grave

explanation.walkthrough: Bury is also an English town with a football club, which misleads.
explanation.definitionFit: To inter is to bury a body, and Inter is the short name of the Milan football club.

indicators.note: the tailpiece of a word is its last letter, here dropped

parts.note: a plane is an aircraft

explanation.surface: Design a plane that has no tail section.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without tailpiece' drops the final E of PLANE.
explanation.definitionFit: To plan something is to devise or think it up.

indicators.note: rattling shakes things up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A woman is unsettling the legal profession.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rattling' rearranges THE BAR; 's is a link meaning 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Bertha is a woman's name, so it can stand for a she.

clue.text: They have their points, but not at night

definitions.text: They have their points, but not at night

parts.words: They have their points, but not at night
parts.note: sounds like grudging praise of people, but means garden timekeepers whose pointer casts a shadow only in daylight

explanation.definitionFit: A garden timepiece has a pointer, the gnomon, that only works in sunlight.

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
rises means gets up

explanation.surface: A sales representative stands to give the numbers again.
explanation.definitionFit: Reprises are repeated passages in music, so repeat figures.

parts.note: the first half, story, means a tale
the second half, books, gives NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.walkthrough: 'storybooks' splits into 'story' and 'books'; NT is the New Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: A talent is a natural ability, a gift.
